description: Ohio motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: An Ohio motorcycle temporary permit holder may
options: Ride only in daylight, with no passengers, off interstates, in a helmet and eye protection
Ride at night as long as a licensed rider follows close behind on another motorcycle
Carry one adult passenger in daylight if both of them wear helmets and eye protection
Ride on interstates after holding the permit for 30 days without any traffic violation
questions.explanation: The Ohio BMV lists daylight riding only, no passengers, no interstates or congested roads, and a helmet and eye protection for permit holders (ORC 4511.53).

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Ohio?

provenance.manual: Section 4511.53 | Rules for bicycles, motorcycles, and snowmobiles.

questions.q: What does Ohio law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
questions.explanation: Ohio: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

questions.q: What does Ohio require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Ohio: eye protection is required for all riders.

provenance.manual: Section 4511.53 | Rules for bicycles, motorcycles, and snowmobiles.

questions.q: In Ohio, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Ohio issues a motorcycle permit at 15½ years at the earliest.
